title: Calendars
intro: Write the sessions of your meetings into the participants' Google or Outlook calendars, with one account of the workspace, and read their availability to avoid conflicts.
name: Name
tokenKept: A secret is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
removeConfirm: Remove {name}? The meetings using it stop being synced; events already written stay in the calendars.

secret.google: Private key of the service account

hints.google: In Google Cloud, create a service account and give it domain-wide delegation for the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar in the Google Workspace admin console. Events are created by the organizer, who invites the participants.
hints.microsoft: In Microsoft Entra, register an application with the Calendars.ReadWrite application permission (admin consent). Events are created in the organizer's calendar, who invites the participants.

useIt: Then, in the settings of a meeting, Schedule → Calendars.
